items.title: Spain asks EU's Frontex for help in processing Ceuta migrants
items.description: Of the over 70,000 migrants who illegally crossed into Ceuta from Morocco in late July, some 5,000 still remain in the Spanish exclave. Ceuta residents have been angrily protesting their continued presence.

sections.title: Beyond Climate & EU — World News Highlights

items.title: Close race as Iceland votes on whether to restart talks on joining EU
items.description: Turbulent international affairs have brought the vote forward, but the campaign has focused more on Iceland's vital fishing industry.

items.title: Shootings surge as drug gangs torment Brussels
items.description: This year alone there have been more than 65 shootings in the Belgian capital, as drug crime soars.

items.title: Serbia: Keeping EU, Russia in play ahead of key election
items.description: As Serbia heads towards an uncertain election, President Aleksandar Vucic is balancing ties with Russia and EU ambitions. But growing geopolitical tensions and pressure at home are narrowing his room to maneuver.

items.title: Iceland holds knife-edge referendum on EU membership talks
items.description: The Nordic nation shelved earlier plans to join the EU over fishing rights, but geopolitics, including Trump's threat to seize Greenland, has prompted a rethink.
